points.description: States the core process: merge sort divides the array into two halves, sorts each half (recursively), and then merges the sorted halves into one sorted array.
points.partial_credit: 2 marks if only part is stated (e.g. only splits into halves, or only merges sorted parts) or the idea is vague or has a minor error.

points.description: Mentions that the merge step combines the two already-sorted halves (the term 'merge'/'merging' of sorted arrays is used).
points.partial_credit: 0.5 if merging is mentioned but not clearly of sorted halves.

rubric.notes: Full marks for a brief statement that the array is split in two, each half is sorted, and the sorted halves are merged, in any wording. Part marks if only one or two of the steps are given, or the description is vague (e.g. 'it divides and combines'). No marks for describing a different sort or only general talk about sorting without splitting and merging.
